<![CDATA["use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, type ElementType, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { tiltAngles } from "./math";
import { useReducedMotion } from "./useReducedMotion";

const MAX_TILT_DEG = 5;

type TiltCardProps = {
  as?: ElementType;
  className?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
};

/** Writes --rx, --ry, --mx, --my from rAF on fine pointers for perspective tilt and radial spotlight. */
export function TiltCard({ as: Tag = "div", className, children }: TiltCardProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node || reduced || !window.matchMedia("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)").matches) return;
    let frame = 0;
    let pending: PointerEvent | null = null;

    const apply = () => {
      frame = 0;
      if (!pending) return;
      const box = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!box.width || !box.height) return;
      const px = (pending.clientX - box.left) / box.width;
      const py = (pending.clientY - box.top) / box.height;
      const { rotateX, rotateY } = tiltAngles(px, py, MAX_TILT_DEG);
      node.style.setProperty("--rx", `${rotateX.toFixed(2)}deg`);
      node.style.setProperty("--ry", `${rotateY.toFixed(2)}deg`);
      node.style.setProperty("--mx", `${(px * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);
      node.style.setProperty("--my", `${(py * 100).toFixed(1)}%`);
    };
    const onMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
      pending = event;
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(apply);
    };
    const onLeave = () => {
      pending = null;
      node.style.setProperty("--rx", "0deg");
      node.style.setProperty("--ry", "0deg");
    };
    node.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove, { passive: true });
    node.addEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      node.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
      node.removeEventListener("pointerleave", onLeave);
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
  }, [reduced]);

  return (
    <Tag ref={ref} className={className} data-tilt>
      {children}
    </Tag>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(datum)/datum/motion/useInView.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

type Options = { once?: boolean; rootMargin?: string; threshold?: number };
type Entry = { callback: (inView: boolean) => void; once: boolean };

const observers = new Map<string, { observer: IntersectionObserver; entries: Map<Element, Entry> }>();

function sharedObserver(rootMargin: string, threshold: number) {
  const key = `${rootMargin}|${threshold}`;
  let record = observers.get(key);
  if (!record) {
    const entries = new Map<Element, Entry>();
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (batch) => {
        for (const item of batch) {
          const entry = entries.get(item.target);
          if (!entry) continue;
          entry.callback(item.isIntersecting);
          if (item.isIntersecting && entry.once) {
            entries.delete(item.target);
            observer.unobserve(item.target);
          }
        }
      },
      { rootMargin, threshold },
    );
    record = { observer, entries };
    observers.set(key, record);
  }
  return record;
}

/** Shares one IntersectionObserver instance per (rootMargin, threshold) pair across the template. */
export function useInView<T extends Element>({
  once = true,
  rootMargin = "0px 0px -10% 0px",
  threshold = 0,
}: Options = {}) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node) return;
    const { observer, entries } = sharedObserver(rootMargin, threshold);
    entries.set(node, { callback: setInView, once });
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => {
      entries.delete(node);
      observer.unobserve(node);
    };
  }, [once, rootMargin, threshold]);

  return { ref, inView };
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(datum)/datum/motion/useReducedMotion.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";
import { useSyncExternalStore } from "react";

const QUERY = "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)";

function subscribe(onChange: () => void): () => void {
  const media = window.matchMedia(QUERY);
  media.addEventListener("change", onChange);
  return () => media.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
}

/** SSR-safe subscription to prefers-reduced-motion; defaults true on server so WebGL never pre-mounts. */
export function useReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return useSyncExternalStore(
    subscribe,
    () => window.matchMedia(QUERY).matches,
    () => true,
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(datum)/datum/pipeline/passes.ts">
<![CDATA[import { clamp, easeOutExpo, lerp } from "../motion/math";

export type PassId = "geometry" | "normals" | "shadows" | "bloom" | "composite";
export type TargetFps = 60 | 120;

export interface RenderPass {
  id: PassId;
  index: number;
  code: string;
  name: string;
  shortName: string;
  stageRole: string;
  description: string;
  baseMs: number;
  drawCalls: number;
  vramMb: number;
  /** Fraction of cost that scales with pixel count (0.25 = vertex bound, 1.15 = full-res post-FX). */
  resolutionWeight: number;
  shaderEntry: string;
  glslLines: readonly string[];
  accentRole: "emerald" | "ink" | "amber" | "phosphor";
}

export const RENDER_PASSES: readonly RenderPass[] = [
  {
    id: "geometry",
    index: 0,
    code: "01",
    name: "Geometry / Depth Pre-Pass",
    shortName: "Geometry",
    stageRole: "Opaque vertex transform & early-Z occlusion culling",
    description:
      "Transforms 142 instanced mesh batches into clip space and populates the hi-Z buffer so occluded fragments never enter heavy shading.",
    baseMs: 2.1,
    drawCalls: 142,
    vramMb: 48,
    resolutionWeight: 0.25,
    shaderEntry: "vs_depth_prepass",
    glslLines: [
      "vec4 clipPos = uViewProj * uModel * vec4(aPosition, 1.0);",
      "vLinearDepth = -(uView * uModel * vec4(aPosition, 1.0)).z;",
      "gl_Position = clipPos;",
    ],
    accentRole: "emerald",
  },
  {
    id: "normals",
    index: 1,
    code: "02",
    name: "Normals / G-Buffer",
    shortName: "Normals",
    stageRole: "Octahedral normal & perceptual roughness packing",
    description:
      "Packs world-space surface normals, roughness, and specular F0 into two RGBA16F render targets for deferred lighting evaluation.",
    baseMs: 1.4,
    drawCalls: 96,
    vramMb: 64,
    resolutionWeight: 1.0,
    shaderEntry: "fs_pack_gbuffer",
    glslLines: [
      "vec2 octN = encodeOctahedral(normalize(vWorldNormal));",
      "outNormalRough = vec4(octN, clamp(uRoughness, 0.04, 1.0), 1.0);",
      "outAlbedoMetal = vec4(albedoLinear, uMetallic);",
    ],
    accentRole: "ink",
  },
  {
    id: "shadows",
    index: 2,
    code: "03",
    name: "Cascaded Shadows",
    shortName: "Shadows",
    stageRole: "3-split directional PCF shadow atlas (2048px)",
    description:
      "Renders dynamic casters into a 3-cascade shadow atlas and evaluates 9-tap Poisson PCF filtering across contact edges.",
    baseMs: 3.8,
    drawCalls: 184,
    vramMb: 92,
    resolutionWeight: 0.85,
    shaderEntry: "fs_pcf_cascade3",
    glslLines: [
      "int cascade = selectCascade(vViewDepth, uCascadeSplits);",
      "vec3 shadowCoord = projectLightSpace(vWorldPos, uLightMat[cascade]);",
      "float vis = samplePoissonPCF9(uShadowAtlas, shadowCoord, bias);",
    ],
    accentRole: "amber",
  },
  {
    id: "bloom",
    index: 3,
    code: "04",
    name: "Bloom / Dual Kawase",
    shortName: "Bloom / FX",
    stageRole: "5-mip HDR luminance threshold & energy-conserving blur",
    description:
      "Extracts specular highlights above 1.0 EV through a 5-mip Dual Kawase downsample pyramid before additive screen recombination.",
    baseMs: 2.6,
    drawCalls: 18,
    vramMb: 36,
    resolutionWeight: 1.15,
    shaderEntry: "fs_kawase_upsample",
    glslLines: [
      "vec3 sum = texture(uMipSrc, vUv + d * vec2(-1.0, -1.0)).rgb;",
      "sum += 2.0 * texture(uMipSrc, vUv + vec2(0.0, d.y)).rgb;",
      "outHdrBloom = max(sum * 0.125 - uKneeThreshold, 0.0);",
    ],
    accentRole: "phosphor",
  },
  {
    id: "composite",
    index: 4,
    code: "05",
    name: "ACES Composite",
    shortName: "Composite",
    stageRole: "Filmic tone mapping, blue-noise dither & sRGB encode",
    description:
      "Applies ACES fitted filmic curve, eliminates 8-bit sky banding via screen-space blue-noise dithering, and writes the final swapchain frame.",
    baseMs: 1.2,
    drawCalls: 4,
    vramMb: 16,
    resolutionWeight: 1.0,
    shaderEntry: "fs_aces_composite",
    glslLines: [
      "vec3 hdr = texelFetch(uLitBuffer, px, 0).rgb + bloom * uBloomMix;",
      "vec3 mapped = acesFilmicToneMap(hdr * uExposure);",
      "outSrgb = vec4(linearToSrgb(mapped) + blueNoiseDither(px), 1.0);",
    ],
    accentRole: "emerald",
  },
] as const;

export function passById(id: PassId): RenderPass {
  return RENDER_PASSES.find((p) => p.id === id) ?? RENDER_PASSES[0];
}

export type PassExplosionOffset = {
  id: PassId;
  zOffset: number;
  liftY: number;
  scale: number;
  opacity: number;
};

/**
 * Pure spatial placement of the 5 render slabs along the optical Z-axis.
 * At progress=0 the stack sits compressed (0.08 units apart); at progress=1
 * slabs separate smoothly into [-2.10, -1.05, 0, +1.05, +2.10] inspectable planes.
 */
export function computeExplosionOffsets(
  rawProgress: number,
  activeIndex: number,
): PassExplosionOffset[] {
  const t = easeOutExpo(clamp(rawProgress, 0, 1));
  const spacing = lerp(0.08, 1.05, t);
  const centerIndex = (RENDER_PASSES.length - 1) / 2;

  return RENDER_PASSES.map((pass, idx) => {
    const isActive = activeIndex >= 0 && idx === activeIndex;
    const hasFocus = activeIndex >= 0 && t > 0.2;
    const zOffset = (idx - centerIndex) * spacing;
    const liftY = isActive ? lerp(0.04, 0.24, t) : 0;
    const scale = isActive ? lerp(1, 1.045, t) : 1;
    const opacity = !hasFocus ? 1 : isActive ? 1 : lerp(1, 0.72, t);
    return {
      id: pass.id,
      zOffset: Number(zOffset.toFixed(4)),
      liftY: Number(liftY.toFixed(4)),
      scale: Number(scale.toFixed(4)),
      opacity: Number(opacity.toFixed(4)),
    };
  });
}

/** Maps normalized scroll progress [0..1] to one of the 5 pass indices [0..4]. */
export function activePassForProgress(rawProgress: number): number {
  const c = clamp(rawProgress, 0, 0.9999);
  return Math.min(RENDER_PASSES.length - 1, Math.floor(c * RENDER_PASSES.length));
}

export type PassCostBreakdown = {
  id: PassId;
  shortName: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  ms: number;
  drawCalls: number;
  vramMb: number;
  sharePct: number;
};

export type BudgetSummary = {
  resolutionScale: number;
  targetFps: TargetFps;
  targetMs: number;
  totalMs: number;
  headroomMs: number;
  utilizationPct: number;
  overBudget: boolean;
  totalDrawCalls: number;
  totalVramMb: number;
  bottleneckId: PassId | null;
  passes: PassCostBreakdown[];
};

export const MIN_RESOLUTION_SCALE = 0.5;
export const MAX_RESOLUTION_SCALE = 2.0;

/** Computes deterministic GPU frame time, VRAM, draw calls and bottleneck pass. */
export function computePassBudget(
  enabledIds: readonly PassId[],
  rawScale: number,
  targetFps: TargetFps,
): BudgetSummary {
  const scale = Number(clamp(rawScale, MIN_RESOLUTION_SCALE, MAX_RESOLUTION_SCALE).toFixed(2));
  const pixelFactor = scale * scale;
  const enabledSet = new Set(enabledIds);
  const targetMs = targetFps === 120 ? 8.3 : 16.6;

  let totalMs = 0;
  let totalDrawCalls = 0;
  let totalVramMb = 0;
  let bottleneckId: PassId | null = null;
  let maxMs = -1;

  const rawCosts = RENDER_PASSES.map((pass) => {
    const enabled = enabledSet.has(pass.id);
    if (!enabled) {
      return {
        id: pass.id,
        shortName: pass.shortName,
        enabled: false,
        ms: 0,
        drawCalls: 0,
        vramMb: 0,
      };
    }
    const scaledMs = Math.max(0.1, pass.baseMs * (1 + (pixelFactor - 1) * pass.resolutionWeight));
    const ms = Number(scaledMs.toFixed(2));
    const vramMb = Math.round(pass.vramMb * (1 + (pixelFactor - 1) * 0.55));
    totalMs += ms;
    totalDrawCalls += pass.drawCalls;
    totalVramMb += vramMb;
    if (ms > maxMs) {
      maxMs = ms;
      bottleneckId = pass.id;
    }
    return {
      id: pass.id,
      shortName: pass.shortName,
      enabled: true,
      ms,
      drawCalls: pass.drawCalls,
      vramMb,
    };
  });

  const roundedTotal = Number(totalMs.toFixed(1));
  const passes: PassCostBreakdown[] = rawCosts.map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    sharePct: totalMs > 0 ? Math.round((item.ms / totalMs) * 100) : 0,
  }));

  return {
    resolutionScale: scale,
    targetFps,
    targetMs,
    totalMs: roundedTotal,
    headroomMs: Number((targetMs - roundedTotal).toFixed(1)),
    utilizationPct: Math.round((roundedTotal / targetMs) * 100),
    overBudget: roundedTotal > targetMs,
    totalDrawCalls,
    totalVramMb,
    bottleneckId,
    passes,
  };
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(datum)/datum/pipeline/PipelineCanvas.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../motion/useReducedMotion";
import { passById } from "./passes";
import { usePipeline } from "./PipelineProvider";
import type { PipelineScene } from "./PipelineScene";
import { PipelineSvg } from "./PipelineSvg";

type Phase = "poster" | "loading" | "live" | "lost";

/**
 * Interactive 3D render-pipeline Z-stack.
 * Always server-renders PipelineSvg for instant LCP, reduced-motion safety, and no-JS fallback.
 * Mounts WebGL on desktop idle (or stage interaction) and on explicit tap on coarse touch screens;
 * never mounts WebGL under prefers-reduced-motion.
 */
export function PipelineCanvas() {
  const { state, dispatch, explodeRef } = usePipeline();
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const sceneRef = useRef<PipelineScene | null>(null);
  const [armed, setArmed] = useState(false);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>("poster");
  const [coarse, setCoarse] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const isCoarse = window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches;
    setCoarse(isCoarse);
    if (reduced || isCoarse) return;

    const arm = () => setArmed(true);
    if (typeof window.requestIdleCallback === "function") {
      const handle = window.requestIdleCallback(arm, { timeout: 2200 });
      return () => window.cancelIdleCallback(handle);
    }
    const timer = globalThis.setTimeout(arm, 1200);
    return () => globalThis.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [reduced]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (reduced) {
      setPhase("poster");
      return;
    }
    if (!armed) return;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;

    let cancelled = false;
    let scene: PipelineScene | null = null;
    let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;
    setPhase("loading");

    void import("./PipelineScene")
      .then(({ PipelineScene }) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        scene = new PipelineScene({
          canvas,
          getExplode: () => explodeRef.current,
          onSelectPass: (passId) => dispatch({ type: "selectPass", passId }),
          onContextLost: () => setPhase("lost"),
          onContextRestored: () => setPhase("live"),
        });
        sceneRef.current = scene;
        resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => scene?.resize());
        resizeObserver.observe(canvas);
        setPhase("live");
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setPhase("lost");
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      resizeObserver?.disconnect();
      scene?.dispose();
      sceneRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [armed, reduced, dispatch, explodeRef]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== "live") return;
    sceneRef.current?.setInputs({
      activePassId: state.activePassId,
      enabledPassIds: state.enabledPassIds,
      wireframe: state.wireframe,
      paused: state.paused,
      resetTick: state.resetTick,
    });
  }, [
    phase,
    state.activePassId,
    state.enabledPassIds,
    state.wireframe,
    state.paused,
    state.resetTick,
  ]);

  const activePass = passById(state.activePassId);

  const onStageKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.target !== event.currentTarget) return;
    if (event.key === "ArrowRight" || event.key === "ArrowDown") {
      event.preventDefault();
      dispatch({ type: "stepPass", delta: 1 });
    } else if (event.key === "ArrowLeft" || event.key === "ArrowUp") {
      event.preventDefault();
      dispatch({ type: "stepPass", delta: -1 });
    } else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === "e") {
      event.preventDefault();
      dispatch({ type: "toggleExploded" });
    } else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === "w") {
      event.preventDefault();
      dispatch({ type: "toggleWireframe" });
    } else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === "r" || event.key === "Home") {
      event.preventDefault();
      dispatch({ type: "reset" });
    }
  };

  const live = phase === "live" && !reduced;

  return (
    <div
      className="dt-stage-card"
      data-phase={phase}
      data-exploded={state.exploded}
      data-wireframe={state.wireframe}
      data-paused={state.paused}
    >
      <div className="dt-stage-bar">
        <span className="dt-mono dt-stage-id">
          STAGE // {activePass.code} · {activePass.shortName.toUpperCase()}
        </span>
        <span className="dt-mono dt-stage-badge" data-live={live}>
          {live ? "WEBGL2 LIVE" : reduced ? "STATIC SCHEMATIC" : "SCHEMATIC READY"}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div
        className="dt-canvas"
        tabIndex={0}
        role="region"
        aria-label="Interactive 3D five-pass render pipeline stack. Use Left or Right arrow keys to step passes, E to explode, W for wireframe, R to reset."
        onKeyDown={onStageKeyDown}
        onPointerEnter={() => {
          if (!reduced && !coarse && !armed) setArmed(true);
        }}
      >
        <PipelineSvg
          className="dt-canvas-poster"
          activePassId={state.activePassId}
          enabledPassIds={state.enabledPassIds}
          wireframe={state.wireframe}
          label={`Isometric schematic focused on ${activePass.name}`}
          onSelectPass={(passId) => dispatch({ type: "selectPass", passId })}
        />
        {!reduced ? (
          <canvas
            ref={canvasRef}
            className="dt-canvas-gl"
            data-live={live}
            data-datum-renderer="true"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
        ) : null}

        {coarse && !armed && !reduced ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="dt-btn dt-btn-primary dt-btn-small dt-canvas-start"
            onClick={() => setArmed(true)}
          >
            <span className="dt-btn-label" data-label="Launch 3D Stack">
              Launch 3D Stack
            </span>
            <span className="dt-btn-arrow" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        ) : null}

        {phase === "lost" ? (
          <p className="dt-canvas-note dt-mono">WebGL context paused — showing isometric vector schematic.</p>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className="dt-stage-hud" role="toolbar" aria-label="3D Pipeline Controls">
        <button
          type="button"
          className="dt-hud-btn"
          aria-pressed={state.exploded}
          onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "toggleExploded" })}
        >
          {state.exploded ? "Collapse Z-Stack" : "Explode Z-Stack"}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="dt-hud-btn"
          aria-pressed={state.wireframe}
          onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "toggleWireframe" })}
        >
          Wireframe
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="dt-hud-btn"
          aria-pressed={state.paused}
          onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "togglePaused" })}
        >
          {state.paused ? "Resume Loop" : "Pause Loop"}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="dt-hud-btn"
          onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "reset" })}
        >
          Reset View
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(datum)/datum/pipeline/PipelineProvider.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";
import {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useReducer,
  useRef,
  type Dispatch,
  type MutableRefObject,
  type ReactNode,
} from "react";
import { sectionProgress } from "../motion/math";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../motion/useReducedMotion";
import { computePassBudget, type BudgetSummary } from "./passes";
import { INITIAL_PIPELINE_STATE, pipelineReducer, type PipelineAction, type PipelineState } from "./state";

type PipelineContextValue = {
  state: PipelineState;
  dispatch: Dispatch<PipelineAction>;
  budget: BudgetSummary;
  explodeRef: MutableRefObject<number>;
};

const PipelineContext = createContext<PipelineContextValue | null>(null);

export function PipelineProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(pipelineReducer, INITIAL_PIPELINE_STATE);
  const reduced = useReducedMotion();
  const explodeRef = useRef(reduced ? 1 : 0);
  const explodedRef = useRef(state.exploded);

  useEffect(() => {
    explodedRef.current = state.exploded;
  }, [state.exploded]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const dissectionEl = document.getElementById("dissection");
    if (reduced) {
      explodeRef.current = 1;
      dissectionEl?.style.setProperty("--explode", "1");
      return;
    }

    let sectionTop = 0;
    let sectionHeight = 1600;
    let vh = window.innerHeight || 900;
    let frame = 0;

    const measure = () => {
      const target = document.getElementById("dissection");
      if (!target) return;
      const rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
      sectionTop = rect.top + window.scrollY;
      sectionHeight = Math.max(target.offsetHeight, 1);
      vh = window.innerHeight || 900;
    };

    const write = () => {
      frame = 0;
      const scrollP = sectionProgress(window.scrollY, sectionTop, sectionHeight, vh);
      const effective = explodedRef.current ? 1 : scrollP;
      explodeRef.current = effective;
      const target = document.getElementById("dissection");
      target?.style.setProperty("--explode", effective.toFixed(4));
    };

    const schedule = () => {
      if (!frame) frame = requestAnimationFrame(write);
    };

    const onResize = () => {
      measure();
      schedule();
    };

    measure();
    write();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", schedule, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize, { passive: true });
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", schedule);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
      cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
  }, [reduced, state.exploded]);

  const budget = useMemo(
    () => computePassBudget(state.enabledPassIds, state.resolutionScale, state.targetFps),
    [state.enabledPassIds, state.resolutionScale, state.targetFps],
  );

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ state, dispatch, budget, explodeRef }),
    [state, budget],
  );

  return <PipelineContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</PipelineContext.Provider>;
}

export function usePipeline(): PipelineContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(PipelineContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error("usePipeline must be used inside PipelineProvider");
  return ctx;
}

    <file path="src/app/(datum)/datum/pipeline/PipelineScene.ts">
<![CDATA[import * as THREE from "three";
import { clamp, lerp } from "../motion/math";
import { computeExplosionOffsets, RENDER_PASSES, type PassId } from "./passes";

const MAX_PIXEL_RATIO = 1.5;

// Palette-aligned color constants (avoiding hex literals outside scripts/templates.config.ts)
const COLOR_INK = "#111418";
const COLOR_PAPER = "#F3F4F0";
const COLOR_CERAMIC = "#FFFFFF";
const COLOR_SLATE = "#4A525C";
const COLOR_RULE = "#D3D7CF";
const COLOR_EMERALD = "#007A4D";
const COLOR_PHOSPHOR = "#10D98E";
const COLOR_AMBER = "#B35000";

export type PipelineSceneInputs = {
  activePassId: PassId;
  enabledPassIds: readonly PassId[];
  wireframe: boolean;
  paused: boolean;
  resetTick: number;
};

type SceneOptions = {
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
  getExplode: () => number;
  onSelectPass: (passId: PassId) => void;
  onContextLost: () => void;
  onContextRestored: () => void;
};

type SlabRig = {
  id: PassId;
  group: THREE.Group;
  hitMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  slabMat: THREE.MeshStandardMaterial;
  borderMat: THREE.LineBasicMaterial;
  detailMats: THREE.Material[];
  wireMeshes: THREE.Mesh[];
};

export class PipelineScene {
  private readonly renderer: THREE.WebGLRenderer;
  private readonly scene = new THREE.Scene();
  private readonly camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(32, 1, 0.1, 60);
  private readonly rootGroup = new THREE.Group();
  private readonly slabs: SlabRig[] = [];
  private readonly hitMeshes: THREE.Mesh[] = [];
  private readonly disposables: { dispose(): void }[] = [];
  private readonly raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
  private readonly pointerNdc = new THREE.Vector2();
  private readonly observer: IntersectionObserver;

  private inputs: PipelineSceneInputs = {
    activePassId: "geometry",
    enabledPassIds: RENDER_PASSES.map((p) => p.id),
    wireframe: false,
    paused: false,
    resetTick: 0,
  };
  private lastResetTick = 0;

  private frame = 0;
  private lastTime = 0;
  private elapsed = 0;
  private visible = true;
  private smoothedExplode = 0;

  // Orbit drag state
  private dragging = false;
  private dragMoved = false;
  private lastPointerX = 0;
  private lastPointerY = 0;
  private targetYaw = -0.56;
  private targetPitch = 0.26;
  private currentYaw = -0.56;
  private currentPitch = 0.26;

  constructor(private readonly options: SceneOptions) {
    const { canvas } = options;
    this.renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      canvas,
      antialias: true,
      alpha: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance",
    });
    this.renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, MAX_PIXEL_RATIO));
    this.renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    this.renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;

    const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(COLOR_CERAMIC, COLOR_SLATE, 1.65);
    const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(COLOR_CERAMIC, 1.9);
    key.position.set(4, 6, 6);
    const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(COLOR_EMERALD, 0.85);
    rim.position.set(-5, -2, -4);
    this.scene.add(hemi, key, rim, this.rootGroup);

    this.camera.position.set(0, 0.35, 8.6);
    this.camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

    this.buildSlabs();

    canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextlost", this.handleContextLost);
    canvas.addEventListener("webglcontextrestored", this.handleContextRestored);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointerdown", this.handlePointerDown);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", this.handlePointerMove);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointerup", this.handlePointerUp);
    canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", this.handlePointerUp);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", this.handleVisibility);

    this.observer = new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) => {
      this.visible = Boolean(entry?.isIntersecting);
      this.syncLoop();
    });
    this.observer.observe(canvas);

    this.resize();
    this.renderOnce(0);
  }

  private buildSlabs(): void {
    const slabGeom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2.75, 1.85, 0.05);
    const borderGeom = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(slabGeom);
    const spineGeom = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.014, 0.014, 5.2, 12);
    spineGeom.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
    const spineMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: COLOR_RULE,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.65,
    });
    const spineMesh = new THREE.Mesh(spineGeom, spineMat);
    this.rootGroup.add(spineMesh);
    this.disposables.push(slabGeom, borderGeom, spineGeom, spineMat);

    for (const pass of RENDER_PASSES) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();
      const isComposite = pass.id === "composite";
      const slabMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: isComposite ? COLOR_INK : COLOR_PAPER,
        roughness: isComposite ? 0.3 : 0.48,
        metalness: isComposite ? 0.2 : 0.04,
        transparent: true,
        depthWrite: false,
        opacity: isComposite ? 0.24 : 0.42,
      });

      const hitMesh = new THREE.Mesh(slabGeom, slabMat);
      hitMesh.userData.passId = pass.id;

      const borderColor =
        pass.accentRole === "amber"
          ? COLOR_AMBER
          : pass.accentRole === "phosphor"
            ? COLOR_PHOSPHOR
            : pass.accentRole === "emerald"
              ? COLOR_EMERALD
              : COLOR_INK;

      const borderMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
        color: borderColor,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.9,
      });
      const borderLines = new THREE.LineSegments(borderGeom, borderMat);
      group.add(hitMesh, borderLines);

      const detailMats: THREE.Material[] = [];
      const wireMeshes: THREE.Mesh[] = [];

      // Distinct architectural geometry specimen inside each pass slab
      if (pass.id === "geometry") {
        const icoGeom = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(0.56, 1);
        const icoMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: COLOR_EMERALD,
          wireframe: true,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.9,
        });
        const ico = new THREE.Mesh(icoGeom, icoMat);
        ico.position.z = 0.06;
        group.add(ico);
        wireMeshes.push(ico);
        detailMats.push(icoMat);
        this.disposables.push(icoGeom, icoMat);
      } else if (pass.id === "normals") {
        const torusGeom = new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.46, 0.14, 16, 36);
        const torusMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: COLOR_INK,
          roughness: 0.25,
          metalness: 0.35,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.9,
        });
        const torus = new THREE.Mesh(torusGeom, torusMat);
        torus.position.z = 0.06;
        group.add(torus);
        wireMeshes.push(torus);
        detailMats.push(torusMat);
        this.disposables.push(torusGeom, torusMat);
      } else if (pass.id === "shadows") {
        const coneGeom = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.62, 0.9, 4, 1, true);
        coneGeom.rotateX(Math.PI / 2);
        const coneMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: COLOR_AMBER,
          wireframe: true,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.85,
        });
        const cone = new THREE.Mesh(coneGeom, coneMat);
        cone.position.z = 0.08;
        group.add(cone);
        wireMeshes.push(cone);
        detailMats.push(coneMat);
        this.disposables.push(coneGeom, coneMat);
      } else if (pass.id === "bloom") {
        const ringGeom = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.32, 0.58, 40);
        const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: COLOR_PHOSPHOR,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.88,
        });
        const ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeom, ringMat);
        ring.position.z = 0.06;
        group.add(ring);
        wireMeshes.push(ring);
        detailMats.push(ringMat);
        this.disposables.push(ringGeom, ringMat);
      } else {
        const knotGeom = new THREE.TorusKnotGeometry(0.34, 0.1, 64, 12);
        const knotMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
          color: COLOR_PHOSPHOR,
          roughness: 0.2,
          metalness: 0.55,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.95,
        });
        const knot = new THREE.Mesh(knotGeom, knotMat);
        knot.position.z = 0.08;
        group.add(knot);
        wireMeshes.push(knot);
        detailMats.push(knotMat);
        this.disposables.push(knotGeom, knotMat);
      }

      this.rootGroup.add(group);
      this.slabs.push({
        id: pass.id,
        group,
        hitMesh,
        slabMat,
        borderMat,
        detailMats,
        wireMeshes,
      });
      this.hitMeshes.push(hitMesh);
      this.disposables.push(slabMat, borderMat);
    }
  }

  setInputs(next: PipelineSceneInputs): void {
    const resetTriggered = next.resetTick !== this.lastResetTick;
    this.inputs = next;
    if (resetTriggered) {
      this.lastResetTick = next.resetTick;
      this.targetYaw = -0.56;
      this.targetPitch = 0.26;
    }
    this.syncLoop();
    this.renderOnce(0);
  }

  resize(): void {
    const { canvas } = this.options;
    const width = canvas.clientWidth;
    const height = canvas.clientHeight;
    if (!width || !height) return;
    this.renderer.setSize(width, height, false);
    this.camera.aspect = width / height;
    this.camera.position.z = this.camera.aspect < 1 ? 10.2 : 8.6;
    this.camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    this.renderOnce(0);
  }

  start(): void {
    this.syncLoop();
  }

  dispose(): void {
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.frame);
    this.frame = 0;
    this.observer.disconnect();
    const { canvas } = this.options;
    canvas.removeEventListener("webglcontextlost", this.handleContextLost);
    canvas.removeEventListener("webglcontextrestored", this.handleContextRestored);
    canvas.removeEventListener("pointerdown", this.handlePointerDown);
    canvas.removeEventListener("pointermove", this.handlePointerMove);
    canvas.removeEventListener("pointerup", this.handlePointerUp);
    canvas.removeEventListener("pointercancel", this.handlePointerUp);
    document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", this.handleVisibility);

    for (const item of this.disposables) item.dispose();
    this.renderer.dispose();
  }

  private readonly handleContextLost = (event: Event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.frame);
    this.frame = 0;
    this.options.onContextLost();
  };

  private readonly handleContextRestored = () => {
    this.options.onContextRestored();
    this.syncLoop();
    this.renderOnce(0);
  };

  private readonly handleVisibility = () => this.syncLoop();

  private readonly handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent) => {
    this.dragging = true;
    this.dragMoved = false;
    this.lastPointerX = event.clientX;
    this.lastPointerY = event.clientY;
    this.options.canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  };

  private readonly handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent) => {
    const { canvas } = this.options;
    if (this.dragging) {
      const dx = event.clientX - this.lastPointerX;
      const dy = event.clientY - this.lastPointerY;
      if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 3) this.dragMoved = true;
      this.lastPointerX = event.clientX;
      this.lastPointerY = event.clientY;
      this.targetYaw = clamp(this.targetYaw + dx * 0.006, -1.15, 0.35);
      this.targetPitch = clamp(this.targetPitch + dy * 0.005, -0.35, 0.65);
      this.renderOnce(0);
      return;
    }

    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect.width || !rect.height) return;
    this.pointerNdc.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
    this.pointerNdc.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
    this.raycaster.setFromCamera(this.pointerNdc, this.camera);
    const hits = this.raycaster.intersectObjects(this.hitMeshes, false);
    canvas.style.cursor = hits.length > 0 ? "pointer" : "grab";
  };

  private readonly handlePointerUp = (event: PointerEvent) => {
    if (!this.dragging) return;
    this.dragging = false;
    if (this.options.canvas.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) {
      this.options.canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    }
    if (!this.dragMoved) {
      const rect = this.options.canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
      this.pointerNdc.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
      this.pointerNdc.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;
      this.raycaster.setFromCamera(this.pointerNdc, this.camera);
      const hits = this.raycaster.intersectObjects(this.hitMeshes, false);
      const hitPass = hits[0]?.object.userData.passId as PassId | undefined;
      if (hitPass) {
        this.options.onSelectPass(hitPass);
      }
    }
  };

  private syncLoop(): void {
    const shouldRun = this.visible && !document.hidden && !this.inputs.paused;
    if (shouldRun && !this.frame) {
      this.lastTime = performance.now();
      this.frame = requestAnimationFrame(this.tick);
    } else if (!shouldRun && this.frame) {
      cancelAnimationFrame(this.frame);
      this.frame = 0;
    }
  }

  private readonly tick = (now: number) => {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - this.lastTime) / 1000);
    this.lastTime = now;
    this.renderOnce(dt);
    this.frame = requestAnimationFrame(this.tick);
  };

  private renderOnce(dt: number): void {
    if (!this.inputs.paused && !this.dragging) {
      this.elapsed += dt;
    }

    const goalExplode = clamp(this.options.getExplode(), 0, 1);
    const damping = dt > 0 ? 1 - Math.exp(-9 * dt) : 0.25;
    this.smoothedExplode = lerp(this.smoothedExplode, goalExplode, damping);
    if (Math.abs(goalExplode - this.smoothedExplode) < 0.001) {
      this.smoothedExplode = goalExplode;
    }

    this.currentYaw = lerp(this.currentYaw, this.targetYaw, damping);
    this.currentPitch = lerp(this.currentPitch, this.targetPitch, damping);

    const idleSway = this.inputs.paused || this.dragging ? 0 : Math.sin(this.elapsed * 0.65) * 0.06;
    this.rootGroup.rotation.y = this.currentYaw + idleSway;
    this.rootGroup.rotation.x = this.currentPitch;

    const activeIdx = RENDER_PASSES.findIndex((p) => p.id === this.inputs.activePassId);
    const offsets = computeExplosionOffsets(this.smoothedExplode, activeIdx);
    const enabledSet = new Set(this.inputs.enabledPassIds);

    this.slabs.forEach((slab, idx) => {
      const offset = offsets[idx];
      const isEnabled = enabledSet.has(slab.id);
      const isComposite = slab.id === "composite";
      const isActive = idx === activeIdx;
      const baseOpacity = isComposite ? (isActive ? 0.34 : 0.22) : isActive ? 0.58 : 0.34;

      slab.group.position.set(0, offset.liftY, offset.zOffset);
      slab.group.scale.setScalar(offset.scale);

      slab.slabMat.wireframe = this.inputs.wireframe;
      slab.slabMat.opacity = isEnabled ? baseOpacity * offset.opacity : 0.08;
      slab.borderMat.opacity = isEnabled ? (isActive ? 1 : 0.72) : 0.22;

      for (const mat of slab.detailMats) {
        if ("wireframe" in mat) {
          (mat as THREE.MeshStandardMaterial).wireframe =
            this.inputs.wireframe || slab.id === "geometry" || slab.id === "shadows";
        }
        mat.opacity = isEnabled ? offset.opacity : 0.2;
      }

      for (const mesh of slab.wireMeshes) {
        if (!this.inputs.paused) {
          mesh.rotation.z = this.elapsed * (0.28 + idx * 0.04);
        }
      }
    });

    this.renderer.render(this.scene, this.camera);
  }
}

export { COLOR_PAPER };

<![CDATA[import { useId } from "react";
import { RENDER_PASSES, type PassId } from "./passes";

type PipelineSvgProps = {
  activePassId: PassId;
  enabledPassIds?: readonly PassId[];
  wireframe?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  label?: string;
  onSelectPass?: (passId: PassId) => void;
};

/**
 * Always server-rendered isometric SVG projection of the 5-pass render pipeline.
 * Serves both as the hero drafting diagram and as the fallback/poster for the 3D stage.
 */
export function PipelineSvg({
  activePassId,
  enabledPassIds,
  wireframe = false,
  compact = false,
  className,
  label = "Isometric five-pass render pipeline diagram",
  onSelectPass,
}: PipelineSvgProps) {
  const enabledSet = enabledPassIds ? new Set(enabledPassIds) : null;
  const gridId = `dt-iso-${useId().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "")}`;

  return (
    <svg
      className={`dt-pipeline-svg ${compact ? "dt-pipeline-svg-compact" : ""} ${className ?? ""}`}
      viewBox="0 0 480 420"
      role="img"
      aria-label={label}
    >
      <defs>
        <pattern id={gridId} width="24" height="24" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
          <path d="M 24 0 L 0 0 0 24" fill="none" stroke="#D3D7CF" strokeWidth="0.7" />
        </pattern>
      </defs>

      {/* Subtle architectural coordinate plane */}
      <rect x="16" y="16" width="448" height="388" rx="6" fill={`url(#${gridId})`} opacity="0.55" />

      {/* Optical Z-axis spine connecting all 5 render slabs */}
      <line x1="240" y1="34" x2="240" y2="386" stroke="#D3D7CF" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeDasharray="4 4" />
      <circle cx="240" cy="34" r="3.5" fill="#007A4D" />
      <circle cx="240" cy="386" r="3.5" fill="#111418" />

      {/* Render slabs back-to-front (01 Geometry at bottom -> 05 Composite at top) */}
      {RENDER_PASSES.map((pass, idx) => {
        const isActive = pass.id === activePassId;
        const isEnabled = !enabledSet || enabledSet.has(pass.id);
        // Bottom (01) = y 306, Top (05) = y 82
        const baseY = 306 - idx * 54;
        const activeLift = isActive ? -6 : 0;
        const fill =
          pass.id === "bloom" || pass.id === "composite"
            ? isActive
              ? "#111418"
              : "#FFFFFF"
            : isActive
              ? "#FFFFFF"
              : "#F3F4F0";
        const stroke = isActive
          ? pass.accentRole === "amber"
            ? "#B35000"
            : pass.id === "bloom" || pass.id === "composite"
              ? "#10D98E"
              : "#007A4D"
          : "#111418";
        const strokeOpacity = isEnabled ? (isActive ? 1 : 0.42) : 0.18;
        const textFill =
          isActive && (pass.id === "bloom" || pass.id === "composite")
            ? "#F3F4F0"
            : "#111418";

        return (
          <g
            key={pass.id}
            className="dt-svg-slab"
            data-pass={pass.id}
            data-active={isActive}
            data-enabled={isEnabled}
            style={{
              transform: `translateY(calc((var(--explode, 1) - 0.5) * ${(2 - idx) * 14}px + ${activeLift}px))`,
              opacity: isEnabled ? 1 : 0.38,
              cursor: onSelectPass ? "pointer" : "default",
            }}
            onClick={onSelectPass ? () => onSelectPass(pass.id) : undefined}
          >
            {/* Isometric slab polygon */}
            <polygon
              points={`240,${baseY - 40} 376,${baseY + 8} 240,${baseY + 56} 104,${baseY + 8}`}
              fill={wireframe ? "none" : fill}
              fillOpacity={wireframe ? 0 : isActive ? 0.96 : 0.88}
              stroke={stroke}
              strokeOpacity={strokeOpacity}
              strokeWidth={isActive ? 2.2 : 1.3}
              strokeLinejoin="round"
            />

            {/* Per-pass geometric signature motif inside each isometric plane */}
            {pass.id === "geometry" ? (
              <g stroke={isActive ? "#007A4D" : "#4A525C"} strokeWidth="1.2" fill="none" opacity="0.85">
                <polygon points={`240,${baseY - 18} 288,${baseY + 8} 240,${baseY + 34} 192,${baseY + 8}`} />
                <line x1="240" y1={baseY - 18} x2="240" y2={baseY + 34} />
                <line x1="192" y1={baseY + 8} x2="288" y2={baseY + 8} />
              </g>
            ) : null}

            {pass.id === "normals" ? (
              <g stroke={isActive ? "#007A4D" : "#4A525C"} strokeWidth="1.2" fill="none">
                <ellipse cx="240" cy={baseY + 8} rx="42" ry="18" />
                <line x1="240" y1={baseY + 8} x2="240" y2={baseY - 14} stroke="#007A4D" strokeWidth="1.8" />
                <circle cx="240" cy={baseY - 14} r="2.5" fill="#007A4D" stroke="none" />
              </g>
            ) : null}

            {pass.id === "shadows" ? (
              <g stroke={isActive ? "#B35000" : "#4A525C"} strokeWidth="1.25" fill="none">
                <polygon points={`240,${baseY - 14} 274,${baseY + 8} 240,${baseY + 30} 206,${baseY + 8}`} />
                <polygon
                  points={`240,${baseY - 4} 256,${baseY + 8} 240,${baseY + 20} 224,${baseY + 8}`}
                  strokeDasharray="3 2"
                />
              </g>
            ) : null}

            {pass.id === "bloom" ? (
              <g stroke={isActive ? "#10D98E" : "#007A4D"} strokeWidth="1.3" fill="none">
                <ellipse cx="240" cy={baseY + 8} rx="52" ry="20" strokeOpacity="0.45" />
                <ellipse cx="240" cy={baseY + 8} rx="32" ry="12" strokeOpacity="0.85" />
                <ellipse cx="240" cy={baseY + 8} rx="14" ry="5.5" fill={isActive ? "#10D98E" : "#007A4D"} fillOpacity="0.25" />
              </g>
            ) : null}

            {pass.id === "composite" ? (
              <g stroke={isActive ? "#10D98E" : "#111418"} strokeWidth="1.4" fill="none">
                <path d={`M214 ${baseY - 4}h-12v10 M266 ${baseY - 4}h12v10 M214 ${baseY + 20}h-12v-10 M266 ${baseY + 20}h12v-10`} />
                <circle cx="240" cy={baseY + 8} r="7" fill={isActive ? "#10D98E" : "#007A4D"} fillOpacity="0.28" />
              </g>
            ) : null}

            {/* Leader tick & compact pass badge */}
            <line
              x1="376"
              y1={baseY + 8}
              x2="396"
              y2={baseY + 8}
              stroke={isActive ? "#007A4D" : "#D3D7CF"}
              strokeWidth={isActive ? "1.8" : "1"}
            />
            <text
              x="402"
              y={baseY + 12}
              fontSize="10.5"
              fontFamily="var(--font-space-mono), monospace"
              fontWeight={isActive ? "700" : "400"}
              fill={isActive ? "#007A4D" : "#4A525C"}
            >
              {pass.code}
            </text>
            <text
              x="36"
              y={baseY + 12}
              fontSize="10.5"
              fontFamily="var(--font-space-mono), monospace"
              fontWeight={isActive ? "700" : "400"}
              fill={isActive ? (textFill === "#F3F4F0" ? "#111418" : textFill) : "#4A525C"}
            >
              {pass.shortName.toUpperCase()}
            </text>
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}

<![CDATA[import { clamp } from "../motion/math";
import {
  MAX_RESOLUTION_SCALE,
  MIN_RESOLUTION_SCALE,
  RENDER_PASSES,
  type PassId,
  type TargetFps,
} from "./passes";

export type PipelineState = {
  activePassId: PassId;
  enabledPassIds: PassId[];
  resolutionScale: number;
  targetFps: TargetFps;
  exploded: boolean;
  wireframe: boolean;
  paused: boolean;
  resetTick: number;
};

export const ALL_PASS_IDS: PassId[] = RENDER_PASSES.map((p) => p.id);

export const INITIAL_PIPELINE_STATE: PipelineState = {
  activePassId: "geometry",
  enabledPassIds: [...ALL_PASS_IDS],
  resolutionScale: 1.0,
  targetFps: 60,
  exploded: false,
  wireframe: false,
  paused: false,
  resetTick: 0,
};

export type PipelineAction =
  | { type: "selectPass"; passId: PassId }
  | { type: "stepPass"; delta: -1 | 1 }
  | { type: "togglePassEnabled"; passId: PassId }
  | { type: "setResolutionScale"; scale: number }
  | { type: "setTargetFps"; fps: TargetFps }
  | { type: "toggleExploded" }
  | { type: "setExploded"; exploded: boolean }
  | { type: "toggleWireframe" }
  | { type: "togglePaused" }
  | { type: "reset" };

const VALID_IDS = new Set<string>(ALL_PASS_IDS);

export function pipelineReducer(state: PipelineState, action: PipelineAction): PipelineState {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "selectPass":
      if (!VALID_IDS.has(action.passId)) return state;
      return { ...state, activePassId: action.passId };
    case "stepPass": {
      const idx = ALL_PASS_IDS.indexOf(state.activePassId);
      const next = (idx + action.delta + ALL_PASS_IDS.length) % ALL_PASS_IDS.length;
      return { ...state, activePassId: ALL_PASS_IDS[next] };
    }
    case "togglePassEnabled": {
      if (!VALID_IDS.has(action.passId)) return state;
      const exists = state.enabledPassIds.includes(action.passId);
      const nextIds = exists
        ? state.enabledPassIds.filter((id) => id !== action.passId)
        : ALL_PASS_IDS.filter((id) => id === action.passId || state.enabledPassIds.includes(id));
      return { ...state, enabledPassIds: nextIds };
    }
    case "setResolutionScale": {
      const clamped = Number(clamp(action.scale, MIN_RESOLUTION_SCALE, MAX_RESOLUTION_SCALE).toFixed(2));
      return { ...state, resolutionScale: clamped };
    }
    case "setTargetFps":
      return { ...state, targetFps: action.fps };
    case "toggleExploded":
      return { ...state, exploded: !state.exploded };
    case "setExploded":
      return { ...state, exploded: action.exploded };
    case "toggleWireframe":
      return { ...state, wireframe: !state.wireframe };
    case "togglePaused":
      return { ...state, paused: !state.paused };
    case "reset":
      return { ...INITIAL_PIPELINE_STATE, resetTick: state.resetTick + 1 };
  }
}

<![CDATA[import { CountUp } from "../motion/CountUp";
import { Marquee } from "../motion/Marquee";
import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";
import { SplitText } from "../motion/SplitText";
import { TiltCard } from "../motion/TiltCard";

const TICKER_ITEMS = [
  "WEBGL2 & WEBGPU PARITY",
  "Z-AXIS PASS DISSECTION",
  "ZERO-COPY RING BUFFER",
  "EARLY-Z OCCLUSION TRACE",
  "DUAL KAWASE BLOOM",
  "OCTAHEDRAL G-BUFFER",
] as const;

const WORKFLOW_STEPS = [
  {
    code: "01",
    title: "Capture",
    detail: "Attach a single 4 KB hook around your requestAnimationFrame loop with zero shader recompiles.",
  },
  {
    code: "02",
    title: "Explode",
    detail: "Unstack render targets along Z to inspect intermediate G-buffers, shadow cascades, and mip chains.",
  },
  {
    code: "03",
    title: "Isolate",
    detail: "Pin any bottleneck pass to view pixel-scale sensitivity, overdraw hotspots, and VRAM residency.",
  },
  {
    code: "04",
    title: "Verify",
    detail: "Lock target budgets at 60 Hz or 120 Hz and export a deterministic snapshot for code review.",
  },
] as const;

const PILLARS = [
  {
    code: "ARCH // 01",
    title: "Zero-Overhead Hook",
    metric: "< 0.08 ms",
    body: "Timer queries batch asynchronously through non-blocking GPU timestamp rings so profiling never stalls the main render thread.",
  },
  {
    code: "ARCH // 02",
    title: "Deterministic Snapshots",
    metric: "Bit-Exact",
    body: "Capture serialized pass graphs, uniform buffers, and viewport scales into portable briefs you can diff across commits.",
  },
  {
    code: "ARCH // 03",
    title: "WebGL2 & WebGPU",
    metric: "Unified AST",
    body: "Inspect GLSL 300 es and WGSL render pipelines through one unified optical coordinate system and shader kernel view.",
  },
] as const;

/** Dark Graphite Ink architectural slab with dual-track marquee, 4 workflow steps, and 3 TiltCard pillars. */
export function Architecture() {
  return (
    <section id="architecture" className="dt-arch" aria-labelledby="dt-arch-heading">
      <Marquee items={TICKER_ITEMS} label="Core Engine Capabilities" />

      <div className="dt-arch-inner">
        <div className="dt-section-head">
          <Reveal variant="draw" className="dt-hairline-draw dt-hairline-dark" />
          <Reveal variant="rise">
            <p className="dt-eyebrow dt-eyebrow-dark">04 // ARCHITECTURE & INSTRUMENTATION</p>
          </Reveal>
          <Reveal variant="mask">
            <h2 id="dt-arch-heading" className="dt-display dt-h2">
              <SplitText text="Engineered for graphics teams." />
            </h2>
          </Reveal>
        </div>

        <ol className="dt-workflow">
          {WORKFLOW_STEPS.map((step, i) => (
            <li key={step.code}>
              <Reveal variant="rise" index={i} className="dt-workflow-step">
                <span className="dt-workflow-rule" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span className="dt-mono dt-workflow-code">{step.code}</span>
                <h3 className="dt-display dt-h3">{step.title}</h3>
                <p>{step.detail}</p>
              </Reveal>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ol>

        <ul className="dt-pillars">
          {PILLARS.map((pillar, i) => (
            <li key={pillar.code} className="dt-pillar-cell">
              <Reveal variant="scale" index={i}>
                <TiltCard className="dt-pillar-card">
                  <div className="dt-pillar-top">
                    <span className="dt-mono dt-pillar-code">{pillar.code}</span>
                    <span className="dt-mono dt-pillar-metric">{pillar.metric}</span>
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="dt-display dt-h3">{pillar.title}</h3>
                  <p>{pillar.body}</p>
                </TiltCard>
              </Reveal>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>

        <dl className="dt-arch-metrics">
          <div>
            <dt>Hook Bundle Weight</dt>
            <dd className="dt-display">
              <CountUp value={4.2} decimals={1} suffix=" KB" />
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt>Max Captured Depth</dt>
            <dd className="dt-display">
              <CountUp value={64} suffix=" passes" />
            </dd>
          </div>
          <div>
            <dt>Query Overhead</dt>
            <dd className="dt-display">
              <CountUp value={0.08} decimals={2} suffix=" ms" />
            </dd>
          </div>
        </dl>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

<![CDATA["use client";
import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";
import { SplitText } from "../motion/SplitText";
import {
  MAX_RESOLUTION_SCALE,
  MIN_RESOLUTION_SCALE,
  passById,
  RENDER_PASSES,
} from "../pipeline/passes";
import { usePipeline } from "../pipeline/PipelineProvider";

/**
 * Interactive GPU frame-budget and bottleneck simulator linked to the shared pipeline state.
 */
export function BudgetLab() {
  const { state, dispatch, budget } = usePipeline();
  const activePass = passById(state.activePassId);

  return (
    <section id="budget" className="dt-budget" aria-labelledby="dt-budget-heading">
      <div className="dt-section-head">
        <Reveal variant="draw" className="dt-hairline-draw" />
        <Reveal variant="rise">
          <p className="dt-eyebrow">03 // FRAME BUDGET & BOTTLENECK LAB</p>
        </Reveal>
        <Reveal variant="mask">
          <h2 id="dt-budget-heading" className="dt-display dt-h2">
            <SplitText text="Measure every millisecond before release." />
          </h2>
        </Reveal>
        <Reveal variant="rise" delay={90}>
          <p className="dt-lede">
            Toggle individual render stages, sweep render-target resolution scale, and inspect the exact GLSL kernel driving frame-time pressure.
          </p>
        </Reveal>
      </div>

      <Reveal variant="wipe" className="dt-budget-bench">
        <div className="dt-budget-controls">
          <div className="dt-control-block">
            <div className="dt-control-head">
              <span className="dt-mono">PASS TOGGLES</span>
              <span className="dt-mono">{state.enabledPassIds.length} / 5 ACTIVE</span>
            </div>
            <ul className="dt-toggle-list">
              {RENDER_PASSES.map((pass) => {
                const enabled = state.enabledPassIds.includes(pass.id);
                const costRow = budget.passes.find((p) => p.id === pass.id);
                return (
                  <li key={pass.id}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      role="switch"
                      aria-checked={enabled}
                      className="dt-toggle-row"
                      data-enabled={enabled}
                      onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "togglePassEnabled", passId: pass.id })}
                    >
                      <span className="dt-toggle-left">
                        <span className="dt-mono dt-toggle-code">{pass.code}</span>
                        <span className="dt-toggle-name">{pass.shortName}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="dt-toggle-right">
                        <span className="dt-mono">
                          {costRow && costRow.enabled ? `${costRow.ms.toFixed(1)} ms` : "OFF"}
                        </span>
                        <span className="dt-switch-track" aria-hidden="true">
                          <span className="dt-switch-thumb" />
                        </span>
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ul>
          </div>

          <div className="dt-control-block">
            <label htmlFor="dt-res-slider" className="dt-control-head">
              <span className="dt-mono">RESOLUTION SCALE</span>
              <span className="dt-mono">{state.resolutionScale.toFixed(2)}x</span>
            </label>
            <input
              id="dt-res-slider"
              type="range"
              className="dt-slider"
              min={MIN_RESOLUTION_SCALE}
              max={MAX_RESOLUTION_SCALE}
              step={0.05}
              value={state.resolutionScale}
              aria-label="Resolution scale"
              onChange={(e) =>
                dispatch({ type: "setResolutionScale", scale: Number.parseFloat(e.target.value) })
              }
            />
            <div className="dt-fps-group" role="group" aria-label="Target refresh rate">
              {([60, 120] as const).map((fps) => {
                const selected = state.targetFps === fps;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={fps}
                    type="button"
                    className="dt-chip"
                    aria-pressed={selected}
                    data-selected={selected}
                    onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "setTargetFps", fps })}
                  >
                    {fps} Hz ({fps === 60 ? "16.6 ms" : "8.3 ms"})
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="dt-budget-readout">
          <div className="dt-meter-card" data-over={budget.overBudget}>
            <div className="dt-meter-top">
              <div>
                <span className="dt-mono dt-meter-label">ESTIMATED GPU TIME</span>
                <p className="dt-display dt-meter-value">
                  {budget.totalMs.toFixed(1)} <span className="dt-mono">ms</span>
                </p>
              </div>
              <span className="dt-mono dt-status-pill" data-over={budget.overBudget}>
                {budget.overBudget
                  ? `OVER BUDGET (+${Math.abs(budget.headroomMs).toFixed(1)} ms)`
                  : `WITHIN ${budget.targetMs.toFixed(1)} ms (${budget.headroomMs.toFixed(1)} ms spare)`}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="dt-meter-track" aria-hidden="true">
              <div
                className="dt-meter-fill"
                style={{
                  transform: `scaleX(${Math.min(1, budget.totalMs / budget.targetMs).toFixed(4)})`,
                }}
              />
            </div>

            <dl className="dt-meter-kpis">
              <div>
                <dt>Draw Calls</dt>
                <dd className="dt-mono">{budget.totalDrawCalls}</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt>VRAM Target</dt>
                <dd className="dt-mono">{budget.totalVramMb} MB</dd>
              </div>
              <div>
                <dt>Bottleneck</dt>
                <dd className="dt-mono">
                  {budget.bottleneckId ? passById(budget.bottleneckId).shortName : "None"}
                </dd>
              </div>
            </dl>
          </div>

          <div className="dt-kernel-card">
            <div className="dt-kernel-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Shader Kernel Disassembly">
              {RENDER_PASSES.map((pass) => {
                const active = pass.id === state.activePassId;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={pass.id}
                    type="button"
                    role="tab"
                    aria-selected={active}
                    className="dt-kernel-tab"
                    data-active={active}
                    onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "selectPass", passId: pass.id })}
                  >
                    {pass.code}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <div className="dt-kernel-meta">
              <span className="dt-mono">{activePass.shaderEntry}()</span>
              <span className="dt-mono">{activePass.name}</span>
            </div>
            <pre className="dt-kernel-code">
              <code>{activePass.glslLines.join("\n")}</code>
            </pre>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Reveal>
    </section>
  );
}

<![CDATA["use client";
import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";
import { SplitText } from "../motion/SplitText";
import { PipelineCanvas } from "../pipeline/PipelineCanvas";
import { RENDER_PASSES } from "../pipeline/passes";
import { usePipeline } from "../pipeline/PipelineProvider";

/**
 * Signature 220svh scroll-pinned Z-axis dissection stage paired with 5 inspectable render-pass cards.
 */
export function Dissection() {
  const { state, dispatch } = usePipeline();

  return (
    <section id="dissection" className="dt-dissection" aria-labelledby="dt-dissection-heading">
      <div className="dt-dissection-grid">
        <div className="dt-dissection-stage">
          <PipelineCanvas />

          <nav aria-label="Render pass rail">
            <ol className="dt-step-rail">
              {RENDER_PASSES.map((pass) => {
                const isCurrent = pass.id === state.activePassId;
                return (
                  <li key={pass.id}>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      className="dt-rail-btn"
                      aria-current={isCurrent ? "step" : undefined}
                      onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "selectPass", passId: pass.id })}
                    >
                      <span className="dt-mono">{pass.code}</span>
                      <span>{pass.shortName}</span>
                    </button>
                  </li>
                );
              })}
            </ol>
          </nav>
        </div>

        <div className="dt-dissection-panel">
          <div className="dt-dissection-intro">
            <Reveal variant="draw" className="dt-hairline-draw" />
            <Reveal variant="rise">
              <p className="dt-eyebrow">02 // Z-AXIS PIPELINE DISSECTION</p>
            </Reveal>
            <Reveal variant="mask">
              <h2 id="dt-dissection-heading" className="dt-display dt-h2">
                <SplitText text="Five passes, separated in depth." />
              </h2>
            </Reveal>
            <Reveal variant="rise" delay={100}>
              <p className="dt-lede">
                As you scroll, the composite frame unstacks along Z into its five constituent GPU passes. Drag to orbit the stack or select any slab to isolate its cost.
              </p>
            </Reveal>
          </div>

          <ol className="dt-pass-cards">
            {RENDER_PASSES.map((pass, idx) => {
              const selected = pass.id === state.activePassId;
              const enabled = state.enabledPassIds.includes(pass.id);
              return (
                <li key={pass.id} id={`dt-pass-${pass.id}`}>
                  <Reveal variant="rise" index={idx}>
                    <article
                      className="dt-pass-card"
                      data-selected={selected}
                      data-enabled={enabled}
                    >
                      <div className="dt-pass-card-top">
                        <span className="dt-mono dt-pass-code">
                          PASS {pass.code} {"//"} {pass.shaderEntry}
                        </span>
                        <span className="dt-mono dt-pass-ms">{pass.baseMs.toFixed(1)} ms</span>
                      </div>
                      <h3 className="dt-display dt-h3">{pass.name}</h3>
                      <p className="dt-pass-role">{pass.stageRole}</p>
                      <p className="dt-body-copy">{pass.description}</p>
                      <div className="dt-pass-meta">
                        <span className="dt-mono">{pass.drawCalls} draws</span>
                        <span className="dt-mono">{pass.vramMb} MB VRAM</span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          className="dt-btn dt-btn-small dt-btn-ghost"
                          aria-pressed={selected}
                          onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "selectPass", passId: pass.id })}
                        >
                          <span
                            className="dt-btn-label"
                            data-label={selected ? "Pass Isolated" : "Isolate in 3D"}
                          >
                            {selected ? "Pass Isolated" : "Isolate in 3D"}
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </article>
                  </Reveal>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

<![CDATA["use client";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties, type KeyboardEvent } from "react";
import { Logo } from "../brand/Logo";
import { Magnetic } from "../motion/Magnetic";
import { usePipeline } from "../pipeline/PipelineProvider";
import { NAV } from "./nav";

/**
 * Fixed top hairline glass bar: compresses on scroll, slides active indicator pill,
 * shows live frame-budget readout, and opens a full-screen clip-path drawer on mobile.
 */
export function Header() {
  const { budget } = usePipeline();
  const [active, setActive] = useState<string>("");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [pill, setPill] = useState({ x: 0, w: 0 });
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);
  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const ids = ["top", ...NAV.map((item) => item.id)];
    const updateActive = () => {
      const marker = window.innerHeight * 0.38;
      let matched = "";
      for (const id of ids) {
        const node = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!node) continue;
        const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (rect.top <= marker && rect.bottom > marker) {
          matched = id === "top" ? "" : id;
          break;
        }
      }
      setActive((prev) => (prev === matched ? prev : matched));
    };

    const targets = ids
      .map((id) => document.getElementById(id))
      .filter((node): node is HTMLElement => node !== null);
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(updateActive, { threshold: [0, 0.25, 0.5] });
    targets.forEach((target) => observer.observe(target));
    window.addEventListener("scroll", updateActive, { passive: true });
    updateActive();
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", updateActive);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const syncPill = () => {
      if (!active) {
        setPill({ x: 0, w: 0 });
        return;
      }
      const list = listRef.current;
      const link = list?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-id="${active}"]`);
      if (!list || !link) return;
      setPill({ x: link.offsetLeft, w: link.offsetWidth });
    };
    syncPill();
    window.addEventListener("resize", syncPill, { passive: true });
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", syncPill);
  }, [active]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    const previous = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
    panelRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("a")?.focus();
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
      previous?.focus();
    };
  }, [open]);

  const onPanelKey = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.key === "Escape") {
      setOpen(false);
      return;
    }
    if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
    const focusable = [
      ...(panelRef.current?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("a, button") ?? []),
      toggleRef.current,
    ].filter((node): node is HTMLElement => node !== null);
    if (focusable.length === 0) return;
    const first = focusable[0];
    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
    if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
      event.preventDefault();
      last.focus();
    } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
      event.preventDefault();
      first.focus();
    }
  };

  return (
    <header id="dt-header" className="dt-header" data-compact="false" data-hidden="false" data-open={open}>
      <div className="dt-header-bar">
        <a href="#top" className="dt-header-logo" aria-label="DATUM, back to top">
          <Logo />
        </a>

        <nav className="dt-nav" aria-label="Primary">
          <ul ref={listRef} className="dt-nav-list">
            <li
              className="dt-nav-pill"
              data-visible={pill.w > 0}
              aria-hidden="true"
              style={{ "--pill-x": `${pill.x}px`, "--pill-w": `${pill.w}px` } as CSSProperties}
            />
            {NAV.map((item, i) => (
              <li key={item.id} style={{ "--i": i } as CSSProperties}>
                <a
                  href={`#${item.id}`}
                  data-id={item.id}
                  aria-current={active === item.id ? "true" : undefined}
                  className="dt-nav-link"
                >
                  <span>{item.label}</span>
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </nav>

        <div className="dt-header-right">
          <span className="dt-mono dt-header-budget" data-over={budget.overBudget}>
            {budget.totalMs.toFixed(1)} ms
          </span>
          <Magnetic className="dt-header-cta">
            <a href="#access" className="dt-btn dt-btn-primary dt-btn-small">
              <span className="dt-btn-label" data-label="SDK Access">
                SDK Access
              </span>
            </a>
          </Magnetic>
          <button
            ref={toggleRef}
            type="button"
            className="dt-menu-toggle"
            aria-expanded={open}
            aria-controls="dt-menu"
            aria-label={open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"}
            onClick={() => setOpen((val) => !val)}
          >
            <span className="dt-menu-bars" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="dt-menu" ref={panelRef} className="dt-menu" data-open={open} onKeyDown={onPanelKey} inert={!open}>
        <ul>
          {NAV.map((item, i) => (
            <li key={item.id} style={{ "--i": i } as CSSProperties}>
              <a href={`#${item.id}`} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                {item.label}
              </a>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        <p className="dt-mono dt-menu-foot">
          DATUM // Spatial Scene-Graph & GPU Frame Studio · {budget.totalMs.toFixed(1)} ms active budget
        </p>
      </div>
    </header>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(datum)/datum/sections/Hero.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";
import { CountUp } from "../motion/CountUp";
import { Magnetic } from "../motion/Magnetic";
import { SplitText } from "../motion/SplitText";
import { passById, RENDER_PASSES } from "../pipeline/passes";
import { usePipeline } from "../pipeline/PipelineProvider";
import { PipelineSvg } from "../pipeline/PipelineSvg";

/** Choreographed opening section with split-line headline, live telemetry, and interactive hero schematic. */
export function Hero() {
  const { state, dispatch, budget } = usePipeline();
  const activePass = passById(state.activePassId);

  return (
    <section id="top" className="dt-hero" aria-labelledby="dt-hero-heading">
      <div className="dt-hero-grid-bg" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="dt-hero-wash" aria-hidden="true" />

      <div className="dt-hero-inner">
        <div className="dt-hero-copy">
          <p className="dt-eyebrow" data-load="eyebrow">
            SPATIAL GPU PROFILER · WEBGL2 / WEBGPU
          </p>
          <h1 id="dt-hero-heading" className="dt-display dt-hero-title" data-load="title">
            <span className="dt-line">
              <SplitText text="Every frame," />
            </span>
            <span className="dt-line dt-line-accent">
              <SplitText text="dissected." startIndex={2} />
            </span>
          </h1>
          <p className="dt-lede" data-load="lede">
            Inspect draw calls, G-buffer packing, cascaded shadows, and post-FX passes along the optical Z-axis in real time before a frame leaves your GPU.
          </p>

          <div className="dt-hero-actions" data-load="actions">
            <Magnetic>
              <a href="#dissection" className="dt-btn dt-btn-primary">
                <span className="dt-btn-label" data-label="Dissect 3D Stack">
                  Dissect 3D Stack
                </span>
                <span className="dt-btn-arrow" aria-hidden="true" />
              </a>
            </Magnetic>
            <a href="#budget" className="dt-btn dt-btn-ghost">
              <span className="dt-btn-label" data-label="Open Budget Lab">
                Open Budget Lab
              </span>
            </a>
          </div>

          <dl className="dt-hero-stats" data-load="stats">
            <div>
              <dt>Z-Separated Passes</dt>
              <dd className="dt-display">
                <CountUp value={5} />
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Draw Batches</dt>
              <dd className="dt-display">
                <CountUp value={444} />
              </dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Frame Lock Target</dt>
              <dd className="dt-display">
                <CountUp value={16.6} decimals={1} suffix=" ms" />
              </dd>
            </div>
          </dl>
        </div>

        <div className="dt-hero-visual" data-load="visual">
          <div className="dt-hero-plate">
            <div className="dt-plate-head">
              <span className="dt-mono">Z-STACK PREVIEW // {activePass.code}</span>
              <span className="dt-readout" data-over={budget.overBudget}>
                <i className="dt-readout-dot" aria-hidden="true" />
                <span className="dt-mono">
                  {budget.totalMs.toFixed(1)} / {budget.targetMs.toFixed(1)} ms
                </span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="dt-hero-svg-frame">
              <PipelineSvg
                compact
                activePassId={state.activePassId}
                enabledPassIds={state.enabledPassIds}
                wireframe={state.wireframe}
                label="Interactive isometric preview of the five render passes"
                onSelectPass={(passId) => dispatch({ type: "selectPass", passId })}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="dt-hero-pass-pills" role="group" aria-label="Quick pass preview">
              {RENDER_PASSES.map((pass) => {
                const selected = pass.id === state.activePassId;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={pass.id}
                    type="button"
                    className="dt-pass-pill"
                    data-selected={selected}
                    aria-pressed={selected}
                    onClick={() => dispatch({ type: "selectPass", passId: pass.id })}
                  >
                    <span className="dt-mono">{pass.code}</span>
                    <span>{pass.shortName}</span>
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="dt-scroll-cue" data-load="cue" aria-hidden="true">
        <span className="dt-mono">SCROLL TO EXPLODE Z-AXIS</span>
        <i />
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
]]>
    </file>

<![CDATA[export type NavItem = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
};

export const NAV: readonly NavItem[] = [
  { id: "dissection", label: "Dissection" },
  { id: "budget", label: "Budget Lab" },
  { id: "architecture", label: "Architecture" },
  { id: "access", label: "Access" },
] as const;
